en.text: We need to back up Abrams!
I like the way you think, Bebop.
Thought I was in trouble there for a moment.
Thanks for keeping me in the fight.
They took out the Rat King!
Oh, I need one of these in my safehouse.
She covered some distance, now didn't she?
Need to work on my abilities…
Need to be careful, I'm all alone…
They could come at me from anywhere…
If I get too greedy I could get caught…
That coulda gone real bad, real quick…
We need to keep this up…
Nice to work with someone who's a team player.
I got you where I want you…
I put a stop to that…
I love it when you make it easy for me, Bebop.
Thanks for standing there for me.
You're making this way too easy, Bebop.
Look out for the black hole.
The turrets aren't getting it done, McGinnis.
She can keep throwing them down and I'll keep breaking 'em.
How many of these damn things is she carrying?
They took the Rejuvenator, we need to be smart.
They have the Rejuv, let's stick together.
Got you right where I want you!
We need to make our move!
That's what I like to see…
The Cursed Apple may not be the place for you, Sheriff.
You've never fought someone like me, Holliday.
I might have to take her revolver.
That gun has history, Holliday…. I want it.
The tome will be mine, Abrams.
This ends when you give me the tome.
That tome will belong to Paradox.
And here I usually like antiques.
She couldn't keep up after all.
Oh I'm not leaving here without that Bench
You're good, Bebop, but you're not good enough.
You're not at my level, Bebop.
Bet she has some rare books worth stealing.
I took care of the bookworm.
Tell your little fairy tales somewhere else.
You tell stories, Paradox exposes the truth.
Their support's out of the picture.
Guess he was a move behind.
There's a fine line between wisdom and hubris.
I wiped that smug look off his face.
That jet pack's gonna be mine.
Wonderful of Fairfax to supply a new weak point.
One day I'm going to steal that skeleton...
Danny Danny Danny, when are you gonna learn
I will learn the secrets of The Baroness, Doorman.
You can't keep me out of The Baroness forever, Doorman.
He needed to be put down.
For such a brilliant mind you made some stupid choices.
Don't have to worry about that black hole for a while..
You're out of your league, Dynamo.
If the ritual goes bad, I should kidnap him for the Paradox museum.
I'll have to remember to investigate that creature further…
Messing with royals is the best.
Daddy is going to be so disappointed in you.
That Blackmore twat got what was coming to him.
I'm better than you, Apollo, just accept it.
What secrets are you hiding for Fairfax, McGinnis?
I'm going to rob that woman blind.
How long did you think you could hide from Paradox?
Your time is running short, McGinnis.
Smile more, Victor, life is more fun that way.
You're not going to win, Victor.
You're never going to find answers on your own, Victor.
Paradox has your number, Lady Geist.
You really are fun to mess with, Geist.
She really has a high opinion of herself, doesn't she?
I'm not scared of you, Geist.
He's as powerful as they say…
So that's the man that escaped Lost Whisper.
The OSIC isn't particularly impressive, now is it…
You think you could take me out, Haze?
Pissing off Haze was probably a bad idea…
Vindicta isn't a threat to me.
You picked the wrong target, Vindicta.
You never should have tried lighting me on fire.
You've been out of the game too long, Infernus.
We could have worked well together, Kelvin.
Knocked Kelvin off his high horse.
I think I found a new favorite person to mess with.
You made the wrong enemy, Kelvin.
It's a shame, I like those two.
Come on, Lash, you gotta do better than that…
You don't get it, Lash: we fight on my terms, not yours.
Your act kind of sucks Sinclair
No one turns me into a rabbit
That bottle is going to look so pretty in The Paradox Museum.
Tell ya what, Mirage, give me the Djinn and I'll let you walk.
That guy needs to lighten up.
You're not better than me, Calico.
I thought she was rather charming, a shame it had to end this way.
Calico didn't have what it takes.
I'm taking that lich hand, one way or another.
The hand has piqued my interest.
Necromancers think they're clever, but it's the same schtick over and over again.
Graves, just go to law school and make your mommy and daddy proud.
I was expecting so much more from him.
Your little owl was never going to catch me.
Was wondering when they'd send you after me.
Knew this was bound to happen one day.
Stop yelling about your problems and start fixing them, Billy.
Get out of my way, Billy.
That bat isn't going to do you a whole lot of good, Billy.
I'm not gonna let you steal a whole island before I do.
You were always doomed to fail, rat king.
Keep those rabid vermin away from me.
Your crown will be a nice addition to The Paradox Museum
Another Baxter Society errand boy dealt with.
You have knives, I have time… it was never going to be a fair fight.
You're not gonna be stabbing me, Shiv.
I see the prodigal child has returned.
So the heir to Fairfax Industries has graced us with their presence.
Just give me the case, Pocket, save us all some time.
You can change your name, Arin, but I know who you really are.
Ivy, you couldn’t stop me on your best day.
There's different levels to this, Ivy. You aren't ready.
Stick to petty crooks in Spanish Harlem, Ivy.
If this were in aerial silks competition I'd be worried.
That woman would be a great cat burglar, if she toned down the glitter.
Well, she was fun to play with.
Mina, you're not special because your mommy and daddy paid someone to turn you into a vampire.
She probably had more clout before she was turned…
You give thieves a bad name, Vyper.
You're an insult to my profession, Vyper.
You're clever, Viscous, but you're not me.
That cube was only going to last so long…
Warden, you've never faced someone like me in your life.
Don't worry about the Patrons, Warden… worry about me.
That's the woman who thinks she can stop Paradox? Ha!
Yes, Silver, you are a very scary bounty hunter.
Sliver, if you wanna keep throwing away your life, I can't stop you.
And here I thought we could do business.
I'm not afraid of you, Wraith.
The 7th Moon will never run New York.
Paradox will never bend to the 7th Moon.
Yamato, Yamato, Yamato…when will you realize you're not in control?
I can't wait to steal that sword.
Welcome to the dawn of Paradox.
There's no one better than me.
How are you gonna stop me? I manipulate time…
You guys could at least try to stop me…
You think I'm bad now, wait till I get going…
There's more where that came from…
Just me, I need to be smart…
Damn, I'm the only one who got out alive.
I don't have time to sit around.
We're not going to have any problems, right Sheriff?
In that case: Welcome to New York
Don't trust the OSIC. Their goals and your goals are not in alignment.
You think I keep this on all the time?
It's not wise to mock Paradox…
We've been following your work Detective.
We like secrets, and you seem to have a knack for finding them. But a word of advice: some things aren't meant to be revealed. Stop asking questions about us.
With the ritual upon us Paradox has bigger concerns than your nose in our business. So no. You have nothing to fear from me.
Not really. Stealing something is probably what I spend the least amount of time doing. Heists are like 50% research 40% shopping and prep. 8% vacation time and 2% actual larceny.
You're a marvel to behold Bebop. Truly exquisite craftsmanship.
I can't wait to see it.
Between the two of us we'll put them right where we want them.
Bebop… that’s a curious name for a golem.
You gonna let a little thing like hands stop you?
Suppose so, but I bet there's a solution if you try hard enough.
What's with all the questions, are you wearing a wire?
After the ritual I want to play you in chess.
Oh that's not true at all…
At some point they're going to think they escaped us, and then reality is going to hit them.
We're securing a few more items of interest; but hopefully the gallery will be open shortly.
Blackmail on Fairfax, The Ghent Altarpiece, The Tome of Anubis….
Hey Danny… how much is Fairfax paying you.
God, you're the most boring skeleton I've ever met.
Why are you staring at me like that.
I thought you were supposed to be some great salesman.
You're claiming moral superiority over me?
I am annoyed. You don't have anything interesting to steal.
All members of Paradox wear one.
I can just get you a coat.
Don't worry, if they try to run from you I'll bring them back into position.
It's almost like I don't give away secrets for free.
I think you'll enjoy our next event, I'll make sure you get in.
Why do you keep reading books? Haven't you read enough?
Well aren't you your father's son…
After I save your life today, introducing me to your father would be a lovely way to say thank you.
A trip to the family estate then?
If you'd like I can give you a little preview of the next Paradox museum after this.
The verillian locket isn't a trinket.
I'm gonna find out one way or another.
I'm just trying to save us all time.
I don't expect someone like you to appreciate what Paradox brings to the table.
I wouldn't know, art's not really my thing.
Lady, we already robbed you. You're exactly the person to play games with. If you want the painting back I recommend that you try to find it. Good luck.
It had a Hellenistic bust of Homer
We're a bunch of bored rich people, of course we brag about what we stole.
We don't need to explain ourselves to you.
What is it worth to you to have your safehouse's location not exposed.
I won't be threatened by you Seven.
You have until the end of the ritual to consider your answer.
No, our jobs are based on individual interest and challenge.
I would be lying if I didn't say I was curious.
If we win I don't suppose you could put in a good word with the Curator Division for me.
This may surprise you, Haze; but as a Scottish woman I don't particularly give a shit about American artifacts.
You have more sense than I thought.
The patron wouldn't ask for your help if you were just a bartender.
You know how to pique a girls interest.
What can I say, I like a little rube goldberg in my life.
I don't suppose you have any trinkets you'd be willing to donate to the Paradox museum.
Who's to say: we definitely planned on robbing you during the ritual, but my colleague may or may not have broken into your home yet.
Be flattered that you lived a life interesting enough to be robbed by us.
The heart wants what the heart wants Kelvin.
You know you're held in high regard by Paradox, right?
An explorer is just a thief that specializes in stealing from the dead.
I heard a rumor that you were planning on robbing a Paradox museum.
Thank you for the blueprints by the way.
Was in my possession. It's probably in Prague by now.
Oh that was the blackmail-forward one, right?
Yeah, that was a good one.
I just wanted to let you know as a courtesy, someone from Paradox is going to come for that hand.
You know, we should work together… I imagine you could learn all sorts of secrets from the dead.
For a necromancer you are terribly boring.
The Baxter Society pulling you out of retirement?
If it did would you tell me?
I really thought you'd be more fun.
I'd love to see the inside of The Manor House
Oh I know what happened to the last member of Paradox that tried to steal from The Baxter society. That's why I want you to get me in.
You're looking spry for an old man.
Don't expect me to carry you if you lag behind.
Father Rourke. How lovely to see you.
You don't have to, the answer will be the same.
You know nothing of Paradox. Like any family we can get competitive with each other, but ultimately we always come together in the end.
I would have expected you to understand, Venator… how sad.
I'm a woman in a helmet, it's not really a giant a mystery.
I don't know if I'd call myself a criminal.
Freemasons aren't actually working with stone. Thieves guild is more of an honorific.
Ivy: We relocate items that are of public interest and share them with the world for free, so can you just get off my arse?
I thought you lived with the Arroyos?
Then I stand by what I said.
I've never done something like that before.
I don't know, but god do I love a challenge.
Nono, I'm not tanking anything, don't worry. But if it all goes bad I'd love to help… if only for the novelty
Why does everyone think I walk around in this thing?
Ya know, you'd make a great second story man.
Basically a fancy name for cat burglar.
Oh, you'd get over that real fast.
I'm just saying if you ever want a career change I can introduce you to people.
The first step is to be somebody.
Sorry, I should have clarified: the first step is to be somebody interesting.
You know Vyper, you may have the subtly of a child in a ball pit, but I sincerely am excited to be working you.
You call yourself a master thief? You've spent more time in jail then outside of it.
Silver, you'd have to have something worth stealing for me to want to rob you.
Don't even think about trying to collect the bounty on me.
I was just thinking about all the werewolves I've met, and that somehow the patron decided that you were the best one for the job.
I have all the time in the world to kill them…
I gotta be smart about this…
Well what do we have here….
I'm not leaving souls lying around…
I don't forget. I don't forgive.
This is getting out of hand…
I don't understand how this happened…
How did I not plan for this…
Someone left some souls lying around…
In time, all men die… the gun just speeds things up.
Trust me, you want me on your side.
People who say you can't out run a bullet have a severe lack of imagination.
Time travel isn't a thing… yet.
Time's wasting. Heh. That was a little time joke, not sure if you picked up on that.
I gave up my name to join Paradox… and it's a choice I would gladly make again.
Don't expect me to explain how this all works, just be happy that it works.
No one can stop me from taking what I want.
It was smart to turn to Paradox for help.
I represent Paradox. And we always get what we want.
I should get something at the store…
Wonder what they're selling at the store.
I wonder what's at the shop now.
Bet I could get something good at the shop.
Might be time to get an item.
I should see what I can afford.
I could get a good item…
I need to spend these souls…
We got what we came for…
It's only a matter of time before we summon the patron…
More time to plan a heist…
You realize I create walls of time, right?
Think I'll take a walk through the museum…
Great, I didn't want to miss the Paradox blackmail party tonight anyway…
You know where to find me if you want my help.
Time manipulation is fun and all, but sometimes you just need explosives.
If you're going to blow something up you might as well do it with style.
And to think, some people waste their time with normal grenades…
Sometimes you need time tricks… other times, you just need explosives.
If they aren't paying attention they're as good as dead…
I hope I get to catch someone shopping…
When this goes off they won't even know what hit 'em…
There's a time for elegance, and a time for brute force…
This will help when we push…
Can't wait to swap people through this…
This is going to infuriate them…
Who doesn't love playing with time…
I don't have time to play fair…
By the time I slow down they'll be dead.
Time this right and it can change the tide of a fight…
Time to pick up the pace.
This is a great way to initiate…
If someone’s by themselves, I'll drag 'em to where I want them to be….
Getting them out of position can make the difference…
One well timed swap can change everything…
I love using this when they try to run away.
They can try to escape… see how that works out for 'em…
I'll move 'em all over the battlefield.
They'll go where I want them to go.
Hope I get to catch someone delivering an urn…
They can shoot me all they want…
I'm not worried about getting shot.
Have I got a surprise for them….
They'll die before they can use their magic…
Those party tricks won't work on me.
Relevant character names from the game Deadlock. Relevant character names from the game Deadlock.
Let's take out the Rat King.
Grey Talon, I can heal you!
Rat King, I can heal you!
Check out what The Doorman bought.
I'm not ready for a team fight
Check out what Grey Talon bought.
Can't wait to tell the Paradox council about this…
This is going to make a hell of an exhibit in the museum.
What did I tell you, Paradox is inevitable.
Time to talk to a god.
It was fun working with you all… we should run another job sometime.
They're not ready for what I've got planned.
Paradox is coming for them, and there's nothing they can do about it.
I'll put them in their place.
I'll make the opening, just be sure you're ready to capitalize.
They aren't going to like what I have planned…
Don't worry, boys and girls… time's on our side.
Check out what Rat King bought.
I'll move them around the battlefield.
I'll try to pull them into position…
I'll try to Swap them into the group.
They'll go where I tell them…
I'll Swap them out of position.
